people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
translations.bsb: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
translations.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
translations.asv: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent unto him from Jerusalem priests and Levites to ask him, Who art thou?
